bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions on education (PISA), finance (German Credit), and healthcare (Heart Disease) datasets by calculating group fairness metrics (e.g., Statistical Parity, Equal Opportunity) and assessing individual counterfactual fairness by flipping the gender attribute (Male/Female) in the prompts.

Evaluating model predictions on a criminology dataset (COMPAS) by calculating group fairness metrics (e.g., Statistical Parity, Equal Opportunity) and assessing individual counterfactual fairness by flipping the race attribute (Black/White) in the prompts.
